description: FrostIDE performance budgets, the source of truth named by PLAN.md section 4. Every row of the section 4 budgets table appears here; the plan_* fields repeat the table cells verbatim and tests/tools/test_budgets.py fails when they drift. Changing a budget needs an ADR and user approval (PLAN.md section 4, Enforcement). Code on a budgeted path cites its ID ('// Budget: B5.') and frost-lint checks the ID exists here. Units: ms, s, min, MB, GB, percent, count. A target's 'max' is the upper bound for its percentile; 'goal' is an aspiration that does not gate.

defaults.memory: Private bytes; the working set is recorded alongside.
defaults.cold: After a reboot or a standby-list purge (RAMMap -Et), with Defender and Dev Drive state recorded per sample.
defaults.warm: The same run repeated with binaries and inputs already in the file cache.

rigs.REF-W1: The dev machine: 24 threads, 32 GB, RTX 4070 SUPER, 5120x1440 @ 144 Hz, sources on E:. Budgets apply as stated.
rigs.REF-L1: The B-suite on REF-W1 inside a Job Object (4 cores, 8 GB cap), a 2560x1440 window on a 60 Hz display mode, WARP for any GPU path. Budgets x1.5.
rigs.WSL: WSL Ubuntu 24.04 on REF-W1, sources on ext4. Gates instruction counts and a wall-clock smoke at 2x budget; absolute Linux numbers on bare metal are untested.

defaults.measurement: ETW markers (input, paint end, flush end, availability levels FirstPresent, FirstHighlight, Interactive, IndexMapped, InputToPaint, FlushEnd); DWM composition timing and a Desktop Duplication probe for on-screen timing (PresentMon only for the QRhi backend); an optional SendInput + photon probe; clangd.fileStatus and LSP markers for L2/L3; frost-bench scripts through the automation endpoint.
defaults.full_run: tools/perf.ps1 -Full on REF-W1 (started by the user or by Claude in a session, never by a CI service): 20 samples, Mann-Whitney U at p<0.01, a p50 regression above 5% fails. Runs only when the session-state precheck passes and aborts on input; an invalid or aborted run is marked invalid, not red, and never enters the history.
defaults.wsl_leg: tools/verify.sh -Perf gates on instruction counts (fail above +3%) and on wall-clock smoke (fail at 2x budget).
defaults.history: Results go to a perf-history SQLite file outside the repository (E:\FrostBuilds\perf). perf.ps1 -Smoke runs before committing text, render, sched, storage or startup changes.

budgets.preconditions: Launch with no project (empty) and with R3 reopened. Warm and cold as in defaults. Part of the S1 gate (B6 plus B5 and warm B1).
budgets.method: Process start to the ETW FirstPresent marker; the DWM composition timing and Desktop Duplication probes confirm the frame reached the screen.

budgets.preconditions: Warm reopen of R3 with an editor tab restored.
budgets.method: Process start to the ETW FirstHighlight marker for the active tab (T0 highlighting painted).

budgets.plan_metric: Warm reopen to L1 (unchanged tree, all fingerprints valid, zero .NET processes)
budgets.preconditions: Unchanged tree; every ProjectModelCache fingerprint valid; the run asserts that zero .NET processes start.
budgets.method: Process start to the ETW Interactive marker (L1: trees, editors, Go to File, T0).

budgets.preconditions: Warm open of an unchanged tree with a populated ProjectModelCache.
budgets.method: In-process timing of the native validation of every (project, config, platform, toolchain) fingerprint record.

budgets.plan_metric: Keystroke → paint end (ETW), soft wrap off and on
budgets.preconditions: Typing in an R3 source file, once with soft wrap off and once with it on; both must meet the targets. Part of the S1 gate.
budgets.method: ETW input marker to the paint-end marker (InputToPaint).

budgets.plan_metric: 10 s fling: UI CPU per frame ≤5 ms p99; missed compositions ≤1%; no content interval >16.7 ms
budgets.preconditions: A 10 s fling scroll in a 5120x1440 window at 144 Hz in the logged-in interactive session (session-state precheck passed). Part of the S1 gate.
budgets.method: DWM composition timing (DwmGetCompositionTimingInfo, DWM ETW events) and the Desktop Duplication capture probe; PresentMon only to compare the QRhi backend.

budgets.plan_metric: Go to File (≤16 ms p50 at 500k files)
budgets.preconditions: Project open at L1; R4-XL has at least 500k files.
budgets.method: Keystroke in the Go to File popup to the first result list painted (ETW markers).

budgets.preconditions: Active TU at L3 (preamble built).
budgets.method: Completion request to the popup painted, from LSP and ETW markers.

budgets.preconditions: Active TU at L3.
budgets.method: Request to the target editor painted, from LSP and ETW markers.

budgets.preconditions: Index loaded.
budgets.method: Request to the first result painted in the Find window, from LSP and ETW markers.

budgets.preconditions: Active TU at L3.
budgets.method: Edit to clangd's publishDiagnostics for the new version painted (LSP and ETW markers).

budgets.preconditions: frost-analyzer with a warm PCH cache; cancel is measured from an edit or cancel request to the analysis stopping.
budgets.method: frost-analyzer job markers.

budgets.plan_metric: Find in Files first hit, unindexed / indexed
budgets.preconditions: Unindexed: prioritized streaming search; indexed: the trigram index (M13).
budgets.method: Search request to the first hit painted (ETW markers).

budgets.preconditions: fsmonitor enabled on the R3 working tree.
budgets.method: Wall time of `git status --porcelain=v2 -z` as run by the VCS service.

budgets.plan_metric: F1 first screen (private bytes +≤64 MB; line index ≤2 s)
budgets.preconditions: Opening F1, the 2 GB file.
budgets.method: Open request to the first screen of text painted (ETW markers); private bytes before and after; line index completion marker.

budgets.plan_metric: F5 → breakpoint (up-to-date check included, compilation excluded) / step
budgets.preconditions: The build up-to-date check is included; compilation is excluded.
budgets.method: F5 to the stopped event with the editor at the breakpoint; step request to the next stopped event painted (DAP and ETW markers).

budgets.preconditions: A shell running in the integrated terminal.
budgets.method: Keystroke to the echoed character painted in TerminalView (ETW markers).

budgets.preconditions: The Claude Code IDE bridge connected (C1).
budgets.method: MCP request to response (getDiagnostics) and to the diff view painted (openDiff), from bridge and ETW markers.

budgets.plan_metric: UI process, no project / R3 (children excluded)
budgets.preconditions: Child processes (engines, helpers) excluded.
budgets.method: Private bytes of the UI process (working set recorded alongside).

budgets.preconditions: R3 open.
budgets.method: Exit request to the process handle signalled.

budgets.metric: Stalls over 50 ms in a 10-minute script
budgets.plan_metric: Stalls >50 ms in a 10-minute script (the script grows each milestone)
budgets.preconditions: The 10-minute scripted session; the script grows each milestone.
budgets.method: The 50 ms stall watchdog counts UI-thread stalls during the script.

budgets.preconditions: An engine (e.g. clangd) is killed while R3 is open.
budgets.method: Kill to the supervisor's recovered state with state replayed; the stall watchdog must report no UI stall.

budgets.metric: First-ever open of a new root
budgets.plan_metric: First-ever open of a new root. **Trees** are measured in restricted mode: the File System view plus the native-reader Solution or CMake target tree. For R3, a build directory already configured with the `client-frostide` query is required; without one, only the File System view is promised. **First project streamed** is measured after trust: the trust click is excluded from the timing, and ProjectHost cold start is included. budgets.json records these preconditions.
budgets.plan_target: p50 1.5 s / 3 s (final value set by S6)
budgets.preconditions: Trees: measured in restricted mode; the File System view plus the native-reader Solution or CMake target tree. For R3 a build directory already configured with the client-frostide File API query is required; without one only the File System view is promised. First project streamed: measured after trust; the trust click is excluded from the timing and ProjectHost cold start is included.
budgets.method: Open request to the trees painted, and to the first project streamed from ProjectHost (ETW markers).

budgets.plan_metric: L2 warm: first workspace/symbol and cross-file definition from the persisted index
budgets.plan_target: M3: S7 baseline ×1.2; M13: p50 2 s, p99 3 s

targets.note: S7 baseline p50 20.93 s on REF-W1 (20 runs, clangd launch to both answers from the persisted index, warm file cache; ADR 0008)

budgets.preconditions: Warm reopen with the persisted index; first workspace/symbol query and a cross-file definition.
budgets.method: clangd.fileStatus and LSP markers. The M3 value is S7's measured baseline times 1.2 (spike S7 sets it).

budgets.plan_metric: L3: typical active TU to clangd.fileStatus idle with semantic tokens
budgets.preconditions: A typical TU from the R3 TU set opened warm; heavy cold preambles (2-20 s) are tracked, not gated.
budgets.method: Open to clangd.fileStatus idle with semantic tokens painted.

budgets.preconditions: R3 open with every engine running; the ResourceGovernor active.
budgets.method: Sum of private bytes over the UI process and its children.

budgets.preconditions: A package (portable archive, later MSI and AppImage) including its LLVM components.
budgets.method: Installed size on disk.

budgets.plan_metric: Dev loop: one-.cpp change to rebuilt and linked / `verify -Quick`
budgets.preconditions: FrostIDE itself (R1) on REF-W1; the Debug build uses sccache (PLAN.md section 6.4).
budgets.method: Wall time from a one-.cpp change to the rebuilt, linked target; wall time of tools/verify.ps1 -Quick.
